claim: The DATA-cell storage mechanism works. With a two-cell stack added before phase A's classification, the FIRST operand now survives all the way to the output: the emitted first byte is 0, 1, 2, 3 exactly as a varies. This is the first time A's value reaches the output, and it confirms the identified mechanism: state must be stored in a DATA cell, not in a code-block flag.
claim_status: ASSEMBLED, IN REACHED, BOTH OPERANDS LIVE (compare needs a second decrement subroutine)

fix_implemented.design: a two-cell stack (stack_scratch, stack_top) with FLAG_SS_PUSH / FLAG_ST_PUSH / FLAG_ST_POP, added before phase A's classification, so A is pushed and survives the classification and B's read
fix_implemented.why_it_works: the push uses the codebase's own data-cell mechanism: arming FLAG_SS_PUSH and MOVED to the stack cell makes the CELL's test line fire, which is the only way state persists in this codebase
previous_failed_attempts: arming FLAG_A_IS_x inside a .CODE block: no lasting effect, because no data cell tests the flag
the phase gate with R_: consumed the flag on the first exit

compare_block_defect.symptom: the program emits A's value instead of the boolean
compare_block_defect.cause: restoring B into `value` via value_C1 OVERWRITES A, so by the time the mutual-decrement chain runs only one operand is live. And decrement_value is bound to the single `value` cell by its crazy pointers, so a true alternating mutual decrement of two cells is not expressible with one subroutine.
compare_block_defect.concrete_fix: give the machine a SECOND decrement subroutine bound to a second value cell (crazy_value2/value2 plus its own tmp/carry/rot pointers), so compare can decrement A and B alternately and test NO_MORE_CARRY_FLAG after each; the first operand to carry decides. The budget allows it: 33,968 bytes of headroom and the subroutine is about 45 lines.
compare_block_defect.cheaper_alternative: the complement method needs only ONE decrementable cell: A < B iff A + (9 - B) + 1 produces no carry out of the digit. With B in `value`, decrement it 9-B times... which still needs the count. So the second subroutine is the honest route.
